warnings: Three pile caps, each drawn as a plan + elevation. Plan sizes: F1 0.75 x 0.75 (0.15 + 0.45 + 0.15 each way), F2 1.20 x 0.75 (0.15 + 0.45 + 0.45 + 0.15 by 0.15 + 0.45 + 0.15), F3 1.20 x 1.20. Thickness 0.25 (F1, F2) and 0.30 (F3); 0.05 lean concrete 1:3:5 and 0.05 compacted sand below; top of cap 1.00 below ระดับดินเดิม. Piles: hollow hexagonal Dia. 0.15 x 6.00 m, 4 / 6 / 9 per cap.

Mats: F1 '7+7-DB12' and F3 '13+13-DB12' (count = two-way sum, section 0.5); F2 prints the two directions separately, '10-DB12' (leader on the bars seen end-on, i.e. spaced along the 1.20 side) and '7-DB12' (leader on the long bar) -> count 17, both printed in printed_as. F2 is the only non-square cap, so it alone carries depth_mm.
The pile spacing chains (0.15 / 0.45 ...) are dimensions inside one cap, so they stay on the element as *_printed_as and are not grid ticks (section 6b).
The column C1 runs down into each cap (drawn with its ties); no separate pedestal size is printed, so no pedestal fields are added.
